title: Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc. Announces Purchase of Five Hotels
summary: Total of 2,302 rooms acquired for $393.1 million Inland American Lodging Group, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Inland American Real Estate Trust, Inc., announced today that it has acquired five hotels for a total purchase price of approximately $393.1 million. The total includes a three-state, three-property portfolio acquired from DiamondRock Hospitality, as well as two other hotels located in California and Missouri acquired in separate transactions. Marriott San Francisco Airport Waterfront, Burlingame, CA (Photo: Business Wire) Purchase price for the DiamondRock portfolio totaled $262.5 million, or approximately $184,600 per key. It includes 1,422 rooms and more than 153,000 square feet of meeting and banquet space.
